title: test(multiaxis): pin a basis-0 tilt saved after an angle edit as a limit
body:
## What changed

This PR changes no behaviour. It adds a characterisation test and a decision file for #2739.

- `crates/app/tests/tilt_basis0_edited_file.rs` (new, 261 lines): two tests.
- `docs/decisions/2739-tilt-basis0-edited-file.md` (new): the decision, the facts, the manual repair and the dropped options.

## Readings

The test uses the Tormach 770MX + microARC 4 (A only) and a slot drawn from (10,0) to (30,0) at A0 B180.

- A tilt with `basis_version: 0` generates the slot along world Y at X0. Basis 1 generates it along world X at Y0. The cut plane turns 90 degrees about the tool axis.
- The preview and the post agree. The basis-0 operation posts `G1 X0 Y-10` / `X0 Y-30`. A basis-1 operation drawn at (0,-10)..(0,-30) has the same world toolpath and posts the same G1 lines. Basis 1 at the drawn slot posts `X10 Y0` / `X30 Y0`.
- No field in the file tells the edited file from a legal one. A legal pre-#2133 project with A0 B180 at basis 0 (the shape of the "Flat A180" operation in `crates/app/tests/fixtures/legacy-tilt-basis.camproj`) is the same file, byte for byte, as a project that a #2599 build saved after the edit A90 -> A0 B180. The file states no saving build and no edit history. Every build from project v65 to v72 had the defect (v0.24.0 included), and the fixed build also writes v72.

## Decision

No safe load test exists. A warning on the edited file also fires on the legal "Flat A180" project, and the re-entry that the warning asks for moves a correct cut. Thus the load door changes nothing. The release notes carry the limit and the manual repair. This issue closes as a decided limit. The dropped options are in the decision file.

The facts do not show a gouge or a hidden plane: the post states the toolpath that the preview shows.

## Pinning tests

- `tilt_basis0_edited_file::a_basis0_a0_b180_file_posts_the_turned_plane_that_its_preview_shows`
- `tilt_basis0_edited_file::an_edited_basis0_file_is_the_same_file_as_a_legal_unedited_one`

Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`) on 89e3d7c0d: 1 step, 0 failed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test tilt_basis0_edited_file -- -D warnings`: clean. `tilt_basis_compat` and `first_4axis_part` are not changed.

## Not exercised

- A real file from v0.24.0 or an older build: the test makes the file state with a JSON edit of a saved project.
- Machines other than the microARC 4, and other angles where basis 0 and basis 1 differ.
- The stock simulation and the collision verifier on such a file.
- The GUI.

Changelog: Known limit (#2739): a project that a build before this release saved after a change of a tilt angle on an operation from a project file older than version 65 (no tilt basis key) can keep the old plane basis. Such an operation cuts the plane turned 90 degrees from a new operation at the same angles (for example A0 B180), as the preview shows. To repair it, change Tool axis A or B to a different value, set it back, and check the preview before you post.

Effort: high

Fixes #2739

title: fix(ui): the report door sends the project file name, not its path
body:
## What changed

The Report door (#1696, PR #1798) puts the Debug info report into the GitHub new-issue URL. The "Project:" line of that report had the full path of the project file. That path usually has the user name in it, and the browser sends it to github.com.

- `debug_info::shared_report` is a new form of the same report. It gives the project file and the machine file by file name only.
- Review fix: `shared_report` passes its whole text through `report_scrub::scrub_paths`. Each path-like word in each field (status, GPU, machine vendor and model, machine file, project) changes to its last component. A status such as `open failed: <path>` thus sends only the file name.
- A word starts a path when it starts with `/`, `\`, UNC `\`, a drive (`C:\` or `C:/`), `~`, `./` or `../`, or when it has a `\` or two or more `/`.
- Delta-review fix (head `fa6d90ac5`): a path continues over spaces and marks to the last later word of the same line that has a separator. Thus `C:\Users\jane doe\x.camproj`, `OneDrive - Contoso, Ltd\Parts\x.camproj` and `ACME (old) parts/x.camproj` all give `x.camproj`. A reason after a path (`<path>: access denied`) has no separator and stays. Two paths on one line merge into the last file name. One `/` alone (`mm/min`) is not a path.
- Review fix: `report_scrub::last_component` (used by `file_name_only`) reads `/` and `\` on every system. A Windows path in a project that opens on Linux or macOS thus gives its file name. A trailing separator gives the last folder name. A root, a drive, `.` or `..` gives `(no file name)`. A non-UTF-8 name reads lossily.
- `report::report_body` uses `shared_report`. The Report door URL thus has no directory part of a path.
- `debug_info::report` (the Debug info panel in the application) keeps the full paths. The status strip keeps its text. Both stay on the machine.
- An unsaved project still reads `Project: unsaved`.
- The report has no log excerpt, no tool library path and no recent-file list. Thus no other field needs a scrub. The title that the user types is the user's own text and is not scrubbed.
- Decision: `docs/decisions/2744-report-door-file-name.md` (updated: the rule and its known limits).

The look of the dialog does not change: only the data of the URL changes. No label, layout or window changes. No structural assertion changes. No snapshot PNG changes. Screenshots are not necessary.

## Readings

On the merged tree (head `fa6d90ac5`, `origin/main` merged in):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --locked` (from `crates/ui`): 1290 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Pinning tests

- `report_tests::the_report_door_scrubs_a_status_path_that_is_not_the_project` (new). No saved project. The status is `open failed: C:\Users\someone\Documents\secret\part.camproj: ...` and its POSIX twin `/home/someone/secret/part.camproj`. The body and the URL have `part.camproj`. They do not have `someone`, `secret`, `Documents`, `Users` or `home`, as typed or percent-encoded. The in-app report keeps the full path.
- `report_scrub::tests::last_component_reads_both_separators_on_every_system` (new). Windows, POSIX, UNC and mixed forms, trailing separators and the no-file-name cases. The same asserts run on each system.
- `report_scrub::tests::scrub_paths_keeps_only_the_file_name_of_each_path` (new). Drive, POSIX, `~`, UNC, quoted paths, folder names with spaces, a path before a reason, `mm/min` that stays, and a two-line text. Delta review: folder names with `,` (`OneDrive - Contoso, Ltd`), `)` (`ACME (old) parts`), `;` (`Shop; north`) and a closing quote (`"Shop" files`).
- `report_tests::the_report_door_url_has_the_project_file_name_and_no_directory`. A project path in a user home directory and a status with that path. The body and the URL have `Project: bracket.camproj` and no directory part.
- `report_tests::the_body_carries_the_questions_and_the_debug_report` (changed). It embeds `shared_report` and asserts `Project: unsaved`.

## Not exercised

- The real browser and GitHub. The tests check the URL that the door builds, not the page that GitHub opens.
- The tests ran on Windows only. The new asserts do not depend on the system, so they give the same result on Linux and macOS.
- Known limits of the scrub (also in the decision file):
  - A path to a folder keeps the last folder name.
  - A relative path without a root keeps its first word when that word has no separator (`jane doe/x/y` keeps `jane`). No status message of the application has this form.
  - A non-path text with two `/` (for example a GPU driver text) shrinks to its last part.

Changelog: The Report door now sends only the file names of the project, the machine file and each path in the status line to GitHub, not the full paths on your disk.

Effort: medium

Fixes #2744

title: test(app): pin the gouge refusal of each tilted operation kind
body:
## What changed

This PR adds tests only. The new binary `crates/app/tests/tilted_gouge_kinds.rs` audits each operation kind that accepts a tilt.

- Each probe cuts into a correct box part (a synthetic mesh with 12 facets) in a box stock on the 4th-axis mill (`tormach-770mx-microarc4.mch`).
- Each probe runs at A 90 and at A -90. Each probe also runs upright as a guard, except 2D Adaptive. Each pose has its own world.
- The test asserts three things:
  - a blocking verdict at generation (`Warning::Gouge`, or `Warning::StockChamferGouge` for the 2D Chamfer);
  - a refused post (`post blocked`, and `cuts past the finish surface` when the op is tilted);
  - no file is written.

The decision entry is `docs/decisions/2720-tilted-gouge-audit.md`.

## Results

| Kind | Probe | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Face | stock source, cut 1 mm under the part skin | `a_tilted_face_into_the_part_is_refused` | refused |
| Contour | whole part, Outside, a second part 2 mm past the wall along X | `a_tilted_contour_into_a_neighbour_part_is_refused` | refused |
| Pocket | whole part, area offset 3 mm into the part | `a_tilted_pocket_offset_into_the_part_is_refused` | refused |
| 2D Adaptive | whole part, area offset 3 mm into the part | `a_tilted_adaptive_offset_into_the_part_is_refused` (A 90), `a_tilted_adaptive_offset_into_the_part_is_refused_at_a_minus_90` | refused |
| 2D Offset | whole part, area offset 3 mm into the part | `a_tilted_offset2d_offset_into_the_part_is_refused` | refused |
| Engrave | whole part, 7 mm deep on a 3 mm mark budget | `a_tilted_engrave_deeper_than_a_mark_is_refused` | refused |
| Trace | whole part, 7 mm deep on a 3 mm mark budget | `a_tilted_trace_deeper_than_a_mark_is_refused` | refused |
| 2D Chamfer | stock source, the part fills the stock | `a_tilted_chamfer_of_the_stock_into_the_part_is_refused` | refused (`StockChamferGouge`) |
| Circular | stock source, cut 1 mm under the part skin | `a_tilted_circular_into_the_part_is_refused` | refused |
| Slot | - | `tilted_gouge.rs` (#2600), not repeated | refused |

No kind posts a tilted gouge, so this PR files no P1.

## Where a tilted gouge cannot be expressed

- **Contour into its own part:** the app refuses this at create. Side Inside on a whole section is refused ("needs picked rings"). A negative stock to leave is refused ("not usable"). Thus the probe uses a neighbour part. The gap is along X, the tilt axis, so the neighbour stays beside the wall in each pose.
- **2D Chamfer on a part source:** this has no depth law by design, because the chamfer must break the part edge. Thus only the stock-source chamfer (#1631) can express a gouge.

## Readings

- Quick gate `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on 678f3a37e: 1 step, 0 failed. `app suites: tilted_gouge_kinds` is ok in 52 s (10 passed, 0 ignored).

## Not exercised

- B rotation, compound A+B tilts, and `basis_version` 0. All probes use `basis_version` 1, B 0, A 90 or -90.
- Tilts that are not a quarter turn (for example A 30).
- Upright 2D Adaptive: in debug it takes more than 60 s, and the keep law suite (#1603) covers it.
- Picked-ring (Selection) sources. All probes use the whole part or the stock.
- TrochoidalSlot, Probe and PlasmaProfile: they have no tilt.
- Observation: a 2D Adaptive with `optimal_load` 0.5 on this fixture ran for more than 9 minutes in debug. I stopped it. I did not measure it in release. Filed as #2736.

The stale comments near `params.rs:1365` and `sane.rs:112` are not in touched lines, so this PR does not change them.

Changelog: none
Effort: high

Fixes #2720

title: fix(post): rate a hole op by the lower of the material row and the running feed
body:
## What changed

- `operation::feed_rating::rated_feed` now takes the document material too. When the material in force on the setup of the op is the document material, the rating is the lower of these two values:
  - the feed of the tool's cutting-data row for that material;
  - the running feed of the tool.
- The post clause (`feed_rating::problems`) and the seed of a new or retargeted Drill or Thread op (`feed_rating::seed_into`, through `cutting_rows::seed_feed_for_tool` and `cutting_rows::retargeted_params`) use the same rating. Thus the check never refuses a feed that the seed sets.
- A setup whose stock states a different material keeps the rating of its own row. The running feed follows the document material, so it is not a limit for a different material.
- A running feed that is not a positive, finite number does not lower the rating. The row stays the rating then, as before.
- `commands/operation/edit.rs` gives the document material to `retargeted_params`.
- Decision entry: `docs/decisions/2724-hole-feed-running-limit.md` (what was chosen, why, and what was dropped).

No stored value changes. The post refuses by name. It does not change the feed of the op.

## Readings

- Before the fix: DR-0600 with a mild-steel row at 115 mm/min, on a mild-steel document, running feed lowered to 80 mm/min. The Drill op at 115 mm/min gave `verify` `ok: true` and posted (the pin failed at `hole_feed_rating.rs:275`, `left: Bool(true)`).
- After the fix: `verify` is `ok: false`, and `post` refuses with `D: feeds 115 mm/min, above the 80 mm/min that tool DR-0600 states - ...`. A new Drill op on the tool seeds 80 / 80. With the op at 80 mm/min, the program posts, and each drill cycle line has `F80`.

## Pinning tests

- `hole_feed_rating::a_running_feed_lowered_below_the_material_row_is_the_rating` (new). It fails without the fix and passes with it.
- `hole_feed_rating::a_running_feed_raised_above_the_material_row_keeps_the_row_rating` (new, review fix). The running feed is 200 and the steel row is 115. The op at 200 is refused at the post with `D: feeds 200 mm/min, above the 115 mm/min`, and a new Drill op seeds 115 / 115. With `max` in `rated_feed`, this test fails (mutation run, source put back). The running feed alone also gives 200, so this test fails for that rule too.
- `hole_feed_rating::a_stock_material_other_than_the_document_is_rated_by_its_own_row` (new, review fix). The document is mild steel, the stock is brass (row 150), and the running feed is 80. The op at 150 passes `verify`, a new Drill op seeds 150 / 150, and an op at 160 is refused against 150. When the running feed applies for each material, this test fails (mutation run, source put back).
- `hole_feed_rating::a_row_feed_that_is_not_usable_gives_the_running_feed` (new, review note 2). A row feed of 0, NaN, infinity or -5 gives the running feed (90) as the rating.
- The other `hole_feed_rating` tests and `tool_cutting_rows` pass with no change.

Gate on head b60839ed0 (the review fix, merged with `origin/main` at 20c81cbc1):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test hole_feed_rating --test tool_cutting_rows --test cutting_unknown_row --test lathe_workholding_kinds --locked`: 7 + 11 + 9 + 10 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (`lathe_workholding_kinds`, as on main).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --locked`: 287 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: clean.

Earlier quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`) on head 174da2b81: 22 steps, 0 failed.

This pin also covers the row "Drill with a material-specific cutting-data row" of the checklist in #2725 (row E). The other rows of #2725 are not in this PR. Refs #2725

## Not exercised

- A Thread op with a named row and a lowered running feed (same function as the Drill path; the pin uses the Drill).
- Inch projects, tap cycles and the GUI.
- Example goldens: no `examples/*.nc` or `.camproj` changed. The seed changes only when a tool's running feed is below its row for the document material.

Changelog: A Drill or Thread operation that feeds above its tool's running feed is now refused at the post also when the tool has a cutting-data row for the material at a higher feed; a new Drill or Thread operation takes the lower of the two feeds. A project saved before this change can be refused at its next post when a tool's running feed is below its row; the stored feeds do not change.

Effort: high

Fixes #2724

title: feat(2d): support 2D Contour on DXF sketches
body:
Stacked on #2563 (merge #2563 first)

## What changed

- Added `FeatureSel::SketchChain(ChainId)` and `FeatureSel::SketchLayer(String)` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs` and `pick/feature_sel.rs` (`FeatureSel` now derives `Clone` without `Copy`).
- Added ray-to-curve hit testing for DXF sketch primitives in `crates/app/src/pick/sketch_pick.rs` and `pick/feature_pick.rs` with solid-body occlusion.
- Added `ChainOverride` per-chain `side` and `reverse` overrides on `OpParams::Contour` (`PROJECT_VERSION = 73` and `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` updated to version 73).
- Added DXF contour planning, natural nesting vs per-chain generation, `G2`/`G3` arc preservation, and open-chain safety checks in `operation/contour_sketch.rs` and `operation/contour_sketch_pick.rs`.
- Admitted `2D Contour` on DXF sketches in `sketch_model::generation_problem`, `operation/material.rs`, `operation/material_region.rs`, and `operation/job.rs` (`part_solid = false`).
- Extended MCP `list_features`, `set_operation_geometry`, and `get_operation_geometry` in `mcp/features.rs` and `mcp/pick.rs`, and updated `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.
- Updated the UI for sketch chain clicks (`edge_pick.rs`), layer buttons (`geo_page.rs`), per-chain controls (`mill2d_page.rs`, `fields.rs`), chips (`state.rs`), and viewport highlights (`pick_highlight.rs`, `interact.rs`).

## Cause

Previously, `sketch_model::generation_problem` refused all operations on DXF profiles. Also, `FeatureSel` had no sketch keys, and ray picking skipped sketch geometry.

## Tests

- Pins:
  - `crates/app/tests/contour_dxf_sketch.rs`: `whole_plate_auto_nesting_cuts_outer_outside_holes_inside_and_preserves_g2_g3_arcs`, `layer_and_chain_picks_per_chain_overrides_undo_and_project_v73_roundtrip`, `open_chain_safety_refuses_side_compensation_and_g41_by_name`
  - `crates/app/tests/contour_dxf_sketch_verify.rs`: `ray_pick_hits_sketch_line_arc_circle_and_respects_solid_occlusion`, `move_sketch_stock_shift_unresolved_model_height_and_verify_checks`, `mcp_sketch_workflow_picks_chains_layers_sets_overrides_and_generates`
  - `crates/ui/tests/contour_dxf_sketch.rs`: `edge_pick_handles_sketch_chain_replace_shift_append_and_ctrl_toggle`, `state_sketch_layer_pick_per_chain_override_and_generate_produces_ok_status`
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/contour_dxf_sketch.rs`: `geo_page_layer_picker_and_mill2d_per_chain_overrides_work_and_generate`
- Mutations:
  - `sketch_model::generation_problem`: removed the `OpParams::Contour` arm; `whole_plate_auto_nesting_cuts_outer_outside_holes_inside_and_preserves_g2_g3_arcs` failed; restored and passed.
  - `contour_sketch::validate_plan`: bypassed the open-chain guard; `open_chain_safety_refuses_side_compensation_and_g41_by_name` failed; restored and passed.
  - `operation/material.rs::named_material`: removed the `Sketch` arm; `whole_plate_auto_nesting_cuts_outer_outside_holes_inside_and_preserves_g2_g3_arcs` failed; restored and passed.
  - `pick/feature_pick.rs::pick_feature`: removed the `sketch_pick::pick_sketches` call; `ray_pick_hits_sketch_line_arc_circle_and_respects_solid_occlusion` failed; restored and passed.
- Gate and Clippy:
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (fell back to `batch` because `crates/geometry/src/sketch_chains/mod.rs` changed): `895 step(s), 0 failed` (`76.3 min`), including `clippy -D warnings` across all 8 workspace crates (`--all-targets -- -D warnings`).

## Goldens moved

## Not exercised

title: feat(2d): Slot Undercut for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the Slot Undercut operation and the cutters for it.

- **Four cutter kinds** in `camcraft-tools`: `t_slot`, `keyseat`, `dovetail`, `lollipop`. They use the existing tool fields. `diameter` is the head. `flute_len` is the head height. `shank_d` and `shank_len` are the neck. `tip_angle` is the dovetail flank angle. The kind words are additive, so `PROJECT_VERSION` does not change. The starter catalog has one cutter of each kind.
- **One generator** in `camcraft-motion` (`machining2d::undercut`). It cuts a straight slot or a circular slot (DXF-style bulge). It changes Z at one XY station only, outside the wall. It feeds in sideways, cuts the centre pass and the radial stepover passes at one depth, feeds out the same way, then lifts. The pass offset comes from the widest point of the cutter profile, not from the tip.
- **One verify law** in `camcraft-sim` (`Mode::Undercut`, `verify/undercut.rs`). A move that changes Z while material is in or over the head is `Warning::UndercutLift`. It blocks the post. A neck or holder band with material above its bottom is a `ShankHit`. The operation layer reads the two again against the stock that the earlier operations left (`acquit_undercut_by_prior`). A neck slot that an earlier Slot operation cut is then air.
- **The true profile in the solid law.** The solid law judges a dovetail as a frustum and a lollipop as a full ball (`Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`). The head top gets the same allowance as the tip, so a head that stands under its roof is contact and not a gouge.
- **The true profile in the field stock simulation** (`Stock::simulate_undercut`, `Stock::with_partial_undercut`, `SdfTool::Dovetail`). The head and the neck are two convex solids. The field keeps their union. Both the stock view and Simulate playback cut the head and neck with it. Notice `cut_twin_work::twin_tool` maps `SdfTool::Dovetail` to `"dovetail"`.
- **The column engines cut nothing for an undercut.** A column has one top for each (x, y). It cannot hold air below material.
- **App**: `OpParams::SlotUndercut` (kind tag 44, appended), the project file mirror (keeping `0.0` `bulge` and `neck_slot` keys in JSON), the stamp digest, heights, the part solid law for a part source, and the kept-parts law for both stock and part sources.
- **MCP**: `add_operation` with kind `Slot Undercut` (key `slot_undercut`) and `add_tool` with the new kind words. `verify` reports the new finding kind `undercut_lift`. `list_operation_types` and `edit_operation` include `bulge` and `neck_slot` when they equal `0.0`.
- **UI**: the four undercut kinds in the tool editor (`tool_undercut_row.rs` seeds valid defaults, `Flank angle (deg)` / `flank angle °` edits `ToolKind::Dovetail`, and `Corner radius` stays hidden for undercut kinds), the Slot Undercut page (`undercut_page.rs`), and five original icons (SVG masters rendered with `cargo xtask icons`).
- **Docs**: a Slot Undercut section in the 2D operations guide, and `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md`.

## UI screenshots

Before/after renders from the headless `ShellUi` (`1440x960` WGPU) on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and this PR branch (images stored on `mkinney/Camcraft` `pr-screenshots` commit `0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`):

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Tool editor (`DT-20-60` dovetail cutter) | ![Tool editor before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-before.png) | ![Tool editor after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-after.png) |
| Slot Undercut page (`TSlot` in milling setup) | ![Slot Undercut before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-before.png) | ![Slot Undercut after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-after.png) |

## Cause

There was no cutter kind with a head wider than its neck, and no operation for one. The laws for a plain contour are wrong below a roof. The column model reads a pass as a cleared kerf, so a lift through the roof passes as a retract in its own kerf.

## Tests

New pins cover the new behaviour. Each review fix below also has a direct test and mutation check.

- `camcraft-tools --lib` (`107 passed; 0 failed`): `undercut::tests` checks sane cutters, refusals by name, the profile contact point, and the drawn outline.
- `camcraft-motion --lib` (`459 passed; 0 failed; 10 ignored`): `machining2d::undercut::tests` pins single-station Z moves, entry slot refusals, concentric arc slots, profile contact offsets, and input refusals.
- `camcraft-sim --test undercut_laws` (`14 passed; 0 failed`): pins `UndercutLift`, `ShankHit`, `acquit_undercut_by_prior`, `Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`, `Atom::cap`, and `Stock::simulate_undercut`.
- `camcraft-app --test mcp_slot_undercut` (`7 passed; 0 failed`): pins MCP cutting, verification, posting, refusals, `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts`, and `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play` (`8 passed; 0 failed`): pins `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view`.
- `camcraft-app --test stock_play_partial` (`4 passed; 0 failed`): pins `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy`.
- `camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut`: pins four golden CL files. The generator suite and its unchanged goldens now live in `crates/motion/tests/`.
- `camcraft-app --test tool_law` (`5 passed; 0 failed`): pins undercut cutter compatibility.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (`1256 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`): includes `tool_undercut_row::tests`, `tool_cutter_params::each_milling_kind_shows_the_parameters_its_outline_is_drawn_from`, and `tests/tool_undercut.rs` (`new_tool_undercut_kinds_seed_sane_defaults_hide_corner_radius_and_show_dovetail_flank_angle`, `dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius`, and `slot_undercut_page_shows_its_geometry_heights_passes_and_feeds_fields`).

Review-fix mutation checks (guard reverted -> RED, restored -> GREEN):

- UI dovetail flank angle, undercut defaults, and corner-radius filter reverted: RED (`3 failed` across `tests/tool_undercut.rs` and `tool_cutter_params`). Restored: GREEN (`11 passed; 0 failed`).
- `is_part_kept_kind` reverted in `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs`: `a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts` RED (`post` succeeded instead of refusing). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` restored in `crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs`: `list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot` RED (`list_operation_types` omitted `bulge` and `neck_slot`). Restored: GREEN (`7 passed; 0 failed`).
- `stock_play.rs` and `stock_play_head.rs` undercut playback handling reverted: `playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` and `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restoring `stock_play.rs` alone kept `partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy` RED. Restored both: GREEN (`8 passed; 0 failed` and `4 passed; 0 failed`).

Gate on `b95c27b2e52fc8b976ce9372bcc5e4141c247113`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 651 steps with zero failures (45.9 minutes). The merged main revision is `e5b0ca3c1`. It includes #2767, which fixes the four reviewed area-preview failures. The UI unit suite passed 1,258 tests (7 ignored). All 16 UI integration suites passed. `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with zero warnings.

Latest review-fix checks:

- The motion `golden_undercut` suite passed all four tests. Removing the motion test target gave RED. A feed change from 120 to 121 made all four goldens fail. Restoring the suite and feed returned all four tests to GREEN. The four CL files moved without byte changes.
- Reverting the main geometry fix gave exactly the four reviewed frame-cost failures. Restoring it returned all eight frame-cost tests to GREEN.
- The temporary literature audit gave RED on the old decision (0/8 checks) and GREEN on the updated decision (8/8). The decision records checked sources, design choices, and limitations. No audit script or review evidence is on this branch.

Current merge blocker: main advanced to `744c0847b04d54cfc6e3e8b24a21520c40b6bcef` during validation. A later local refresh exposes safety overlaps: `verify/avoid_poly.rs:25` omits `Atom::cap`, and `verify/swept.rs:130` omits `Prof::Dove` and `Prof::Ball` in keep-out dilation. The refresh compile checks and clippy are RED. The gate was stopped after the compile failures. No new collision semantics were selected. Local commit `b8c5cb42e` is not pushed. The pushed head and its GREEN gate remain `b95c27b2e`. The `Addressed:` comment records the blocker.

## Goldens moved

No existing golden changed. Four golden CL files are new:

- `slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`
- `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`

No snapshot PNG changed. Five icon PNGs are new (`cargo xtask icons` wrote them from the new SVG masters and changed no other PNG).

## Not exercised

- The literature search ran during the latest review fix. `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md` records checked handbook, Autodesk behaviour, and research sources for entry, exit, profiles, and field simulation. It records the limits of those sources and the implementation. The search used the web tool because Perplexity was unavailable. The implementation preceded this search.
- Dovetail and lollipop parts are not tested through the app. Their profiles are tested in the sim crate (solid law and field stock) and the generator.
- The program verdict before a post reads the stock from above. It does not show the undercut as removed. The undercut law and the solid law judge the operation instead.
- A flipped WCS and a rotated work offset refuse the kind. An aligned setup and a WCS yaw do not list it. No 3+2 tilt.
- One depth level for each operation. The far end of a blind slot stays square. The centre line is typed, not picked.
- Issue #896 (form cutters with a drawn outline, corner rounding, slitting saw) stays open. This PR adds only the four parametric kinds that #1444 needs.

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the same function. These open PRs change other functions in the same files. The PR that merges second refreshes.

- #2678, #2149: `mcp/job.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `verify/mod.rs`, `verify/probe.rs`, `verify/types.rs`, `ui/state.rs`
- #2675, #2666: `operation/generate.rs`
- #2663: `ui/egui_app/tool_settings.rs`
- #2665, #2662, #1798: `ui/state.rs` (#1798 also `icons.rs`)
- #2594: `ui/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`

#2670, #2563, #1713, #1798, #2665, #2712, #2715, #2730, #2731, #2741, and #2742 merged while this work ran. Their changes are in the branch through the merge of `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`).

Effort: max. The issue did not escalate.

Changelog: Slot Undercut operation for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters: the cutter enters and leaves sideways at depth, a Z move with material over the head is refused, the neck is checked against the slot mouth, and the stock view shows the true undercut.

Fixes #1444

title: fix(motion): cut shallow blind pocket floors
body:
Stacked on #2149 (merge #2149 first)

## What changed

3D Pocket now cuts a 3 mm blind hole at its floor with a 4 mm stepdown.
The level planner adds flat floors inside the first depth interval.
It keeps stock allowance and the existing material, entry, shell, mask and protected-area checks.
It refuses excessive floor levels by name.

This fix changes four motion files and one decision record.
The stack also contains the parent PR changes.

## Cause

The regular depth ladder used levels -4, -8, -12 and -15 for the test hole.
It missed the floor at -3.
The material checks correctly refused every lower level because solid material stood above it.

## Tests

New pins in `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs`:

- `a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor`
- `a_shallow_floor_keeps_stock_allowance_and_the_top_stock_level`
- `excessive_shallow_floor_levels_are_refused_by_name`

The first pin failed on unchanged production code with `Empty("nothing to cut: the model fills the pocket at every level")`.
Both plain and offset-shell paths now cut one level at Z -3.
The independent no-gouge check and the verify check pass.
The existing matrix keeps its no-gouge assertions unchanged and now cuts all 1152 cases.

Mutation checks restored the four original `cut_levels_under` expressions from `upstream/main`.
The checks kept the parent PR wrapper signatures because the complete upstream file has different signatures.
All three new pins failed with the old expressions.
All five blind-floor tests passed after restoration.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 611 steps passed, zero failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The checks ran with the inherited `sccache` wrapper disabled because it stalled before compilation.

## Goldens moved

This fix changes no `.nc` or `.cl` files relative to parent `e11845b0c`.
The required direct comparison with `upstream/main` shows two inherited differences:

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/thread_g76_inch.nc`: the parent has `J0.0314`; upstream has `J0.0315`.
- `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc`: the parent predates this upstream example.

Both differences already exist in `base-2149`.

## Not exercised

The release gate, ignored heavy tests and physical machining were not run.
Floor discovery covers exactly flat upward faces.

## Overlaps

PR #2149 changes `run_plain_with`, `pocket3d_air_split` and `run_rest_with` in `machining3d/entry.rs`.
This branch starts at its tested head `e11845b0c741207e747510d1f221f0dc47aa698f`.
The parent advanced to `39e6c84e87cb22fcbc4499bd8630741a38024cc1` during this gate.
Merge #2149 first, then refresh this branch and run its checks again.
The stack has one level.

Effort: high
Process change: yes
The process change belongs to parent #2149.
Changelog: Cut shallow flat blind floors in 3D Pocket when the stepdown exceeds the hole depth.
Fixes #2088

title: fix(ui): status strip reads "1 Operation" for one operation
body:
## What changed

The status strip formatted the operation count as `"{ops_n} Operations"`. With one operation it read "1 Operations".

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs`: the label uses the existing browser helper `browser_tree::count(ops_n, "Operation")`. It reads "1 Operation" for one operation and "N Operations" for more. The label still shows only when `ops_n > 0`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`: `count` is now `pub(super)`, with a doc line. Its behaviour does not change, thus the browser suffixes ("1 tool", "2 operations") stay the same.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural/ops_count.rs`: a new structural test. `panes.rs` and `structural.rs` are already longer than 400 lines. The change adds no line to `panes.rs`, and the test is a new submodule in the same form as `structural/donate.rs`.

## Tests

Pinned by `the_status_strip_counts_one_operation_in_the_singular_and_two_in_the_plural` (`camcraft-ui` lib, `egui_app::tests::structural::ops_count`):
- The seed document has one operation. The strip paints "1 Operation".
- The test adds a second operation (`Contour2`, through `CommandKind::CreateOperation`). The strip paints "2 Operations".

Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base main`, Linux, 12 cores):

- `ui suites: boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`: ok.
- `ui suites: lib`: 1169 passed, 1 failed. The new test passed. The failed test is `diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` (`crates/ui/src/diag.rs`, not touched by this PR). Its INFO line was missing from the captured output, while the WARN line was there.
- That test passed 3 of 3 times alone. Two more full `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` runs gave 1170 passed, 0 failed. Thus it is flaky in a parallel run, and this PR does not cause it.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The gate ran on the same `crates/` tree on top of PROCESS_VERSION 101. The PR branch is that commit on `v0.24.0`, without the process sync commit of the fork. `git merge-tree` with `upstream/main` shows no conflict.

title: fix(fidelity)!: a stock copy of an incomplete model keeps naming its hole
body:
A stock copied from an incomplete model (#1610) now keeps naming that model's hole after the model is deleted. Before this change, its refusal at the post fell back to "saved before CamCraft recorded mesh fidelity (project v58 or older)". The post still refused it; only the reason given was wrong.


## What changed

The copy's refusal read the hole from the source model by name (`mesh_open::unknown_note`), so once the source was gone the lookup found nothing. Now the copy carries the hole itself (`schema::MeshOpen`), beside the fidelity-unknown sentinel it already carried (#1056):

- **Where the hole is copied:** every place that lands the sentinel on a copy now lands the hole with it:
  - `SetStock` and its undo
  - a setup clone (`CreateSetup` with a datum)
  - an undone `DeleteSetup`
  - `UpdateModel`'s refresh of the copies, and its undo
  - the project loader
- **Where the refusal reads it:** `model_fidelity::op_problem` reads the hole off the entity that carries the sentinel. Two small helpers: `mesh_open::hole_behind` (the twin of `model_fidelity::chord_behind`) and `mesh_open::note_for`.
- **Project file:** the saver already wrote `mesh_open` for any entity that has one. The loader now also accepts it on a `FromModel` stock marked `fidelity_unknown`, and a hole without the mark stays corrupt. This is an incompatible project-file change: #1610's check (commit `35b3422cf`) shipped in v0.21.0 through v0.24.0, and those readers refuse `mesh_open` on any entity that is not a model marked `fidelity_unknown` as corrupt, so a project file written with a hole on a `FromModel` stock row does not open in v0.21.0 to v0.24.0 (main now writes project version 71, which those releases also reject as unsupported). The commit carries `fix(fidelity)!:` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer; see `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md`.

The decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md`.

## How tested

- **New:** `crates/app/tests/stock_copy_hole.rs` (7 tests). A copy carries the hole, and its refusal names the source and the hole:
  - after the source is deleted, and across undo and redo of that delete;
  - after save, load, and a second save that matches byte for byte;
  - through a setup clone and an undone setup delete;
  - through a whole re-import of the source (which clears it) and that re-import's undo;
  - through `SetStock`'s undo.

  The file also checks that a stock with a hole and no mark fails to load as corrupt.
- **Without the fix,** the two "source deleted" tests fail: the refusal reads "saved before CamCraft recorded …".
- **Existing tests:** the `import_step_open_shell` tests from #1610 still pass. Its corrupt-file message check passes too, because the new message keeps the old wording as a prefix.
- **Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green (112 app suites), and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` is clean.

Branched from upstream/main after #1699 merged, not from a cut tag: the code this fixes is not in v0.20.0.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Changelog: Stock copies of incomplete models now keep naming their source model's hole after the source is deleted, and keep naming the hole for projects saved in v0.21.0 to v0.24.0. Breaking: such project files do not open in v0.21.0 to v0.24.0.

Fixes #1700
